connector.name: Ship24 Tracking by ship24.com
connector.registryDescription: Ship24 tracking API as MCP tools: manage trackers, fetch results, list couriers.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.ship24.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.ship24, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Ship24 API key as a Bearer token, e.g. 'Bearer apik_...'
